title: Chapter 1437
text:
Rumble!

The battle between the two Transcendent Grade powers became more and more intense. The battlefield moved quickly in the spatial storm, as if it had split into two balls of light, one black and one green. They were entangled with each other and crazily corroded each other's space. The rumbling of energy vibrations kept ringing out, bursting out with round after round of strong light, as if the world was about to be destroyed.

Endless mechanical soldiers flew out of Han Xiao's godly fortress. From afar, they looked like wisps of black smoke released by the Supreme Heavenly Venerate, turning into thousands of ribbons. Some were like whips, constantly fighting with the countless dancing World Tree Roots, while some released billions of rays, bombarding various parts of the Tree God.

Among them, there were dozens of dust-sized light spots jumping on the Tree God's body alone, tearing apart roots one after another. They were the many Mechanical Oracles under Han Xiao. They had different abilities, and with the support of Mechanical Force, they had strength that far exceeded normal soldiers. They were all elite units.

Under the endless stack of mechanical soldiers, the Supreme Heavenly Venerate's body seemed to grow endlessly. On the other side, the speed at which the World Tree Roots condensed on the Tree God's body grew faster and faster. Under the layers of entanglement, his body also grew rapidly. The two huge objects grew at the same time at a similar speed.

"Hiss, so big …"

Oathkeeper and Clottey looked at the two of them in surprise.

The aftermath of the battle between the Transcendent Grade experts became more and more intense. In order not to be implicated, the two of them had already retreated even further. However, the bodies of Han Xiao and the Tree God still occupied their entire field of vision. They could not even see their full appearance, as if it extended endlessly.

At Oathkeeper and Clottey's level, they naturally did not have giant phobia. However, at this moment, looking at the two huge creatures that were emitting terrifying pressure with every move, they could not help but feel instinctive fear. It was an indescribable fear of existences that exceeded their understanding!

A strong sense of danger lingered in the hearts of the two of them. The more they looked, the more unstable the energy in their bodies became. Their hearts felt like they were about to jump out of their throats. It was as if a Transcendent was unleashing his full strength. To them, it was a scene that they could not even look straight at!

Waves of horror rushed into their minds, making them want to look away. However, their eyes seemed to have left their bodies and were no longer under their control. Their gazes were firmly glued to the two Transcendent Grade experts.

Shua!

At this moment, the Emperor Skysplitter Blade that was burning with dark blue psionic energy tore apart a large space storm and stabbed into the Tree God's body, piercing through it from front to back. However, the roots in the Tree God's body quickly knotted and mended the wound like a needle. At the same time, tiny roots that looked like granulation grew out near the wound and intertwined with each other. In the blink of an eye, the wound was healed.

In addition, a portion of the psionic energy covering the blade had been absorbed by the Tree God's body. He also had the devouring characteristic of the World Tree and would not reject any energy.

At the same time, the slash mark left behind by the Emperor Skysplitter Blade in the space storm spread rapidly, turning into a gap in space, tearing open a passage to a certain secondary dimension.

However, not only were the two of them not pulled in by the secondary dimension's gravitational force, but the anti-gravitational force on their bodies pulled the secondary dimension out. The internal matter gushed out along the space crack, sprinkling on the two of them and the battlefield.

The scene was like a fruit with a hole in its skin that was being clenched tightly, trying to squeeze the juice and flesh out of the hole and turn into a messy mixture.

Swish! Swish!

Swish! Every slash of Han Xiao's would tear open a space crack that led to different secondary dimensions. Very soon, many colorful space tunnels appeared on the battlefield. Countless secondary dimensions spurted out, shooting out streams of matter. All kinds of strange things scattered all over the sky, including all kinds of strange creatures. They were crushed into powder by the aftershocks and merged into the energy storm of the two of them.

Looking inside these space tunnels, one could see that these secondary dimensions were rapidly drying up, as if their bodies were being hollowed out.

Such a battle had already exceeded the range of a Beyond Grade A's ability. Although the aftershocks of their battle could also shatter secondary dimensions, the Beyond Grade As were the ones being sucked in by the secondary dimensions, destroying the secondary dimensions from the inside. As for the Transcendent Grade, with their own gravity, not only did they prevent the secondary dimensions from being sucked in, but they could also pull out the 'intestines' of the secondary dimensions.

The Tree God had been resisting Han Xiao's attacks head-on. As its roots moved, the almost endless power of the World Tree was released. It was like a rolling green wave, combining attack and defense with endless uses. It also infected this area, causing space to be dyed with a faint green light.

Ding!

Right at this moment, with the Tree God as the center, a special spatial fluctuation was suddenly released. Then, a layer of green world seemed to overlap with this area, spreading out an endless light green light and quickly completing its' rooting '.

The next moment, Han Xiao suddenly felt a strong binding force. A portion of his strength was inexplicably suppressed. Not only did the Supreme Heavenly Venerate slow down, but the power of all the mechanical troops also decreased. The power of the Tree God rose in reverse, and it could freely teleport through this area. Its mobility immediately increased.

"It seems to be a dimensional projection …"

With a glance, Han Xiao recognized what this green world shadow was, and his heart skipped a beat.

The Transcendent Grade had already formed an inner space and an inner universe in his body. A second Void Dimension was born in his body, and the Tree God should also have an inner dimension in his body.

The scene before him should be opening up his inner space and summoning a dimensional projection to descend, turning a certain area outside his body into an inner dimension environment and forming his own domain. This way, he could obtain the home field advantage, improve himself, and suppress his opponent.

Furthermore, this domain moved with him. Even if the battlefield kept changing, it would not be affected.

Han Xiaoxin moved his head, connecting with the Void Dimension consciousness in his body. He followed suit and summoned an inner space projection. A gray domain shining with blue lightning immediately spun and opened up, squeezing away the Tree God's green domain.

The negative effects of the Tree God's domain immediately disappeared. Not only did Han Xiao return to normal, but he also felt the huge increase brought about by the domain. Furthermore, the domain around him moved according to his will, like a new sensory organ.

In the spatial storm, grayish-blue and green corroded each other. The Void Domain and the Tree God's domain were clearly separated. Before Han Xiao could savor it, he felt the pressure on his domain and could not help but increase his energy input.

Buzz!

The Void Domain immediately expanded outward, squeezing the Tree God's domain until it was smaller. At the same time, Han Xiao keenly sensed that the increase in his domain had become stronger, while the Tree God's domain had become weaker.

"So this is the normal style of a Transcendent's battle …"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed with a hint of joy.

All these years, he had been exploring the power of the Transcendent Grade by himself. Although he had some gains, he did not have an opponent of the same level or someone to learn from. Although the Tree God was not complete, he was still quite familiar with the use of Transcendent Grade methods. It was enough to give him a lot of inspiration and imitate the other party's techniques.

Just fighting with a Transcendent who knew the ropes would bring him a lot of benefits.

Han Xiaoxin activated Virtual Creation, and the materials in the Divine Fortress were consumed rapidly. In the blink of an eye, a huge live cannon appeared behind him. Its caliber was almost the size of an asteroid, and the muzzle was as deep as a pitch-black abyss.

A cannon of this size was already considered a galactic giant project. It would take a lot of time to build it, but with [Virtual Creation (Pseudo)], it could be built in an instant, and the efficiency was countless times higher.

From Han Xiao's point of view, the biggest characteristic of this ability in battle was to adapt to the situation and create different devices that he needed on the spot according to the situation on the battlefield. It did not matter even if he was not prepared beforehand.

No matter how strong a Mechanic was, he would not dare to say that he could adapt to all situations. For example, he would not build a live cannon of this size for nothing. Now that he realized that the Tree God's energy resistance was a little abnormal, he could use the Virtual Creation to create it. It was convenient and fast … Other than the fact that the materials would not be returned after the temporary creation disappeared, there were basically no flaws.

Hum!

Surging energy accumulated in the barrel of the cannon, and a strong light flashed. A giant bullet the size of a planet shot out with a loud bang, smashing into the Tree God's chest and abdomen with a huge amount of kinetic energy. It was deeply embedded in, and large pieces of broken roots danced in the air.

The next moment, the strong light almost blinded Oathkeeper and Clotti's eyes. They saw the bullet explode, instantly blasting the Tree God into two. Countless bomb fragments with magnetic acceleration shot out, cutting the two halves of the Tree God's body out of shape, riddling it with holes.

Han Xiao was about to give chase, but at this moment, the Tree God's body suddenly shrank rapidly, fusing into a World Tree root and disappearing on the spot.

"We're only halfway through the fight. Why did it run away?"

Han Xiao had shattered this World Tree root, but he did not sense the Tree God's energy. At the same time, the other party's domain also disappeared, and he immediately understood.

The Tree God's domain was equivalent to the 'rooted' area of the World Tree, so it was connected to the World Tree's territory. This meant that the Tree God could teleport back to any corner of its hometown from anywhere. From this point of view, it was very similar to the teleportation of a King.

"Not only is it meat, but it can also run so fast … Tsk, it must be imitating me!"

Han Xiaoxin knew that the Tree God had been chased away by him and shook his head.

The main reason was that the appearance of the Tree God was a little sudden for him, and he was not prepared. However, after sealing the Secret Tree King, he had already completed the goal of this trip. Furthermore, he had accidentally revealed another trump card of the World Tree, so he did not lose out.

Furthermore, with the Tree God's tankiness, he probably would not be able to kill this guy before he grasped the killing power of the Information Form.

However, speaking of which, why didn't this Tree God attack him at the Information Form level just now? Was there some condition to use it, or was it that the 'incomplete' version of the Tree God could not use this move?

"Although this Tree God doesn't seem to be my match, it seems to have the ability to kill Information Forms. I need to be careful … Furthermore, after this battle, my combat strength has been exposed. I don't know how the World Tree will react. I have to think about it carefully."

Han Xiao pondered.

He calmed himself down and opened the interface to take a look. His expression was a little strange.

"However, I didn't expect that a mission could be triggered like this. I thought that the highest challenge mission would be to a Beyond Grade A Super. After all, it's understandable to challenge a Beyond Grade A Super, but to let players challenge a Transcendent … Is it so strange? There's no success rate at all, and it actually triggered a mission."

At this moment, Oathkeeper and Clottey finally relaxed their tense bodies. Their hands and feet were cold, and their hearts were still beating violently.

Although the battle was already over, the terrifying pressure from the two Transcendent Grade Supers had already been deeply imprinted in their memories. It was like the helplessness of an ordinary person riding a small boat in a storm. That indescribable terror that came from their instincts still lingered in their hearts, leaving a deep impression that could not be erased.

"I didn't expect that even a Super of my level would be so afraid. The difference in life levels is too great. Is this the Transcendent Grade …"

Oathkeeper wiped his non-existent cold sweat.

At this moment, he suddenly felt that being an underling was not bad …
